sentences.sk: Tomáš má rád knihy a dnes ide do knižnice.
sentences.en: Tomáš likes books and is going to the library today.

sentences.sk: Knižnica je vedľa školy a otvára sa o desiatej.
sentences.en: The library is next to the school and opens at ten.

sentences.sk: Tomáš príde krátko po otvorení.
sentences.en: Tomáš arrives shortly after opening.

sentences.sk: Pri dverách si odloží mokrý dáždnik.
sentences.en: By the door he puts down his wet umbrella.

sentences.sk: Vonku prší, ale v knižnici je ticho a príjemne.
sentences.en: It is raining outside, but the library is quiet and pleasant.

sentences.sk: Tomáš chce nájsť jednoduchú knihu o zvieratách.
sentences.en: Tomáš wants to find an easy book about animals.

sentences.sk: Najprv sa pozrie na police pri okne.
sentences.en: First he looks at the shelves by the window.

sentences.sk: Vidí knihy o mestách, jedle a cestovaní.
sentences.en: He sees books about cities, food, and travel.

sentences.sk: Knihy o zvieratách tam však nie sú.
sentences.en: But the books about animals are not there.

sentences.sk: Tomáš sa opýta knihovníčky, kde ich nájde.
sentences.en: Tomáš asks the librarian where he can find them.

sentences.sk: Knihovníčka mu ukáže policu na konci miestnosti.
sentences.en: The librarian shows him a shelf at the end of the room.

sentences.sk: Tomáš si vyberie knihu o vtákoch.
sentences.en: Tomáš chooses a book about birds.

sentences.sk: Má veľa obrázkov a krátke texty.
sentences.en: It has many pictures and short texts.

sentences.sk: Sadne si za stôl a prečíta si prvú stranu.
sentences.en: He sits at a table and reads the first page.

sentences.sk: Kniha sa mu páči, preto si ju chce požičať.
sentences.en: He likes the book, so he wants to borrow it.

sentences.sk: Pri pulte ukáže svoj čitateľský preukaz.
sentences.en: At the desk he shows his library card.

sentences.sk: Knihovníčka povie, že knihu môže mať dva týždne.
sentences.en: The librarian says he may keep the book for two weeks.

sentences.sk: Tomáš jej poďakuje a vloží knihu do tašky.
sentences.en: Tomáš thanks her and puts the book in his bag.

sentences.sk: Pred odchodom si vezme svoj dáždnik.
sentences.en: Before leaving he takes his umbrella.

sentences.sk: Doma chce knihu ukázať svojej mladšej sestre.
sentences.en: At home he wants to show the book to his younger sister.

glossary.note: Third person singular, present tense; sa is part of otvárať sa.
Accusative plural of feminine noun polica.
The reflexive si means borrowing for oneself.

questions.explanationEn: Tomáš wants a simple book about animals.
He chooses a book about birds.
The librarian says he may keep it for two weeks.
